images.01: Young Uzbek woman Kamola, 28, graphic designer, mustard-yellow knitted sweater, black hair in a messy bun, lying on a sofa holding a smartphone showing an online shopping cart full of items, guilty happy smile. Bright modern apartment, mint and mustard palette.
images.02: Close-up of a smartphone screen held by a woman's hand with a mustard sleeve, showing a shopping cart app with product thumbnails: a lamp, a dress, a plant, sneakers, a red badge with many items; cozy blurred background.
images.03: Uzbek man Bekzod, 30, short beard, grey t-shirt, standing in a doorway holding a cup of tea, raising one eyebrow skeptically, looking toward the sofa. Bright modern apartment, mint palette.
images.04: Young Uzbek woman Kamola in a mustard sweater, black hair bun, hugging her smartphone to her chest dramatically with closed eyes, like protecting a treasure, sitting on a sofa, comic expression.
images.05: Surreal night scene: dozens of empty abandoned shopping carts standing alone on an empty city street under streetlights, light fog, deep blue and violet palette, mysterious mood.
images.06: Apartment front door opened: a cheerful young Uzbek courier with a cap and orange jacket holding a big stack of delivery boxes, Kamola in a mustard sweater standing surprised in the doorway.
images.06_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the courier now winks and gives a thumbs up, the boxes slightly tilted.
images.07: Living room full of opened delivery boxes: Kamola in mustard sweater holding a new lamp with shocked joyful face, her husband with short beard and grey t-shirt grinning beside her holding an empty wallet turned upside down.
images.08: Evening, Kamola in a mustard sweater sitting on the sofa among the new things, secretly adding a new item to the cart on her phone with a sly smile, warm lamp light.
